reason: insufficient_evidence: no—evidence is sufficient. The README explicitly describes WSL workspace management and command execution behavior, so the plugin is best classified as Files & Terminal integration: it enables selecting WSL directories and runs Agent shell commands in that environment.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 工作区侧边栏提供手动启用的 WSL 开关、发行版与目录选择入口，可将所选 Linux 目录作为 DSH 工作区并在其中运行 bash 命令。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a manual WSL toggle, distribution selector, and Linux directory browser to the DeepSeek Harness web sidebar so a selected WSL directory can be opened as a workspace and used for agent bash execution.

capabilities: Adds a sidebar-based WSL workspace switch and distribution picker in DeepSeek Harness
Browses/selects Linux directories and opens them as DSH workspaces
Executes agent bash commands through wsl.exe inside the selected WSL distribution and directory

reasons.code: 插件提供 WSL 开关、发行版选择和 Linux 目录浏览，并可将所选目录作为 DSH 工作区打开。
文档说明启用 WSL 工作区后 Agent 命令会在对应发行版和 Linux cwd 下通过 wsl.exe 运行 bash。
限制说明中指出进入 Linux 后会使用完整 WSL 权限，建议仅用于可信项目，表明存在运行命令权限风险。
